text:
anna: heads-up folks 1: slight change to the review kickoff materials + a short "FAQ" for timezone and leave exceptions. posting here so managers can share with their teams.

kevin: what changed exactly?

anna: two bullets: 1) managers will see a new "conversion-in-cycle" checkbox for contractors moving to perm (helps calibration reviewers). 2) there's a lightweight emergency exception path (hospitalization, critical family care) that gives up to 7 business days extension on self-assessments after manager confirmation.

lee: who approves the emergency extension? is it people-ops or manager?

anna: manager initiates via People Ops Notes with dates and supporting doc (brief note ok). People Ops approves and records the audit entry. No need for Exec sign-off unless it's >30 days.

pat: timeline impact? will calibration be pushed?

anna: calibration dates stay the same, but we've added two late/overflow blocks on June 2 16:00-18:00 UTC and June 3 08:00-10:00 UTC for managers who need to present exceptions. If a manager needs more time, they must nominate an acting reviewer and cc people-ops.

kevin: can acting reviewer be a peer from another team?

anna: yes. acting reviewer must be at manager level or above and be invited in Lattice as the reviewer. People Ops will update the invite.

hr-bot: FYI: reminder emails will be sent at 5 days and 2 days before original due date. For approved extensions, additional reminders at 72h and 24h before the extended date.

lee: about the "conversion-in-cycle" flag 1: does that change compensation notes or just signal to calibrators?

anna: just a signal for calibration reviewers. Managers still complete the standard form and include a short conversion note (date of hire, expected ramp, suggested level). Compensation discussions happen post-calibration as usual.

pat: small ask: can you pin the FAQ in the kickoff calendar invite and add an example snippet managers can copy into 1:1s?

anna: done. I added a copyable blurb in the kickoff doc and pinned it to #people-ops. Blurb: "If you're on approved leave or experienced a qualifying emergency, ask your manager to log the dates in People Ops Notes. Approved exceptions grant a short extension. Contact people-ops@redwood.com for help."

kevin: what about timezone-specific extensions (EU local holidays)?

anna: continuing the policy we had last cycle: local-holiday accommodations are applied based on profile timezone. If timezone is blank, manager should set it for the employee. People Ops will auto-apply a 3-calendar-day buffer for confirmed local holidays.

hr-bot: deploy: review-kickoff-v3 published 2026-05-10 14:00 UTC

lee: audit trail question: how long are exception records retained?

anna: exception approvals and notes are retained for 18 months in the audit log.

pat: good. i'll brief my managers and share the new blurb in our manager sync tomorrow.

kevin: thanks anna. small follow-up -- can we get a report of who has been granted emergency extensions at the end of the cycle?

anna: yes, people-ops will publish a sanitized summary (no medical details) to managers after close.

pat: thanks everyone :thumbsup:

hr-bot: calendar reminders scheduled + invites updated for overflow blocks.
